strategicSummary:
As White, Ju Wenjun predominantly plays the English Opening as White (33 games, 42% win rate) and plays the Catalan Opening as White (24 games, 54% win rate). When opponents dictate the structure, she performs exceptionally well when she faces the King's Indian Defense as White (23 games, 65% win rate) and when she faces the Sicilian Defense as White (15 games, 67% win rate). Conversely, she struggles when she faces the Slav Defense as White (18 games, 33% win rate) and when she faces the Nimzo-Indian Defense as White (9 games, 22% win rate). She also plays the Reti as White effectively (10 games, 80% win rate), and in specific variations like the Neo-Gruenfeld, she achieves an average evaluation of +0.31 for White (4 games).

As Black, Ju Wenjun primarily plays the Sicilian Defense as Black, achieving a solid 59% win rate across 49 games. When she faces the English Opening as Black, she maintains a positive 55% win rate over 29 games. Her repertoire against 1.d4 includes playing the Nimzo-Indian Defense as Black (17 games, 41% win rate) and playing the King's Indian Defense as Black (17 games, 41% win rate). However, she faces difficulties when she plays the Queen's Gambit Declined as Black, securing only a 25% win rate over 16 games, though she shows better results when she plays the Dutch Defense as Black (10 games, 60% win rate).
